name: Psyche
bio: Fights with a polearm-scythe and assault rifle, and can take to the air. Her passive, Amberlight, stacks buffs on critical hits — built for heavy single-target damage.

skills.name: Chrysalis Dreamweave
skills.desc: Creates 1 [Phantasm] and then flashes forward. This skill can be used at any time without interrupting Psyche's current action. In [Flamboyance] state, this skill is replaced with [Phototaxis].

skills.name: Fluorescent Eclosion
skills.desc: Enters [Flamboyance] state and gains the ability to fly. When in [Flamboyance] state, Psyche can only use skills and shoot. [Flamboyance] state continuously consumes Sanity, and when Sanity drops to 0 or this skill is used again, [Flamboyance] state ends. When Psyche's HP percentage is above 15%, [Flamboyance] state consumes HP instead of Sanity. The consumed HP will be converted into Ultra Shield at a certain percentage.

skills.name: Amberlight
skills.desc: When dealing CRIT damage, Psyche gains one of the following buffs at random: ATK Boost, Skill Damage Boost, or Malaise Boost. Increases Psyche's damage for each buff she gains, up to 12 buffs.

skills.name: Ephemeral as Dew
skills.desc: When using [Fluorescent Eclosion], if Psyche's HP percentage is no less than 75%, gains [Ephemeral as Dew]. [Ephemeral as Dew]: When triggering the effect of Morale/Malaise, it regards Psyche's HP percentage as 1%. This effect can only be triggered once every 90s.

skills.name: Mirth Carries
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and nearby Anemo teammates.
